answer.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, directly matching the problem space where we have the strongest evidence base. Memory_31 and memory_86 both show that simplification and shortening onboarding drive measurable improvements in completion and early adoption. We're verifying these two to confirm the specific mechanisms (field reduction vs. flow duration) before scaling. Activation_messaging (memory_91) provides complementary support for driving engagement post-onboarding. We avoid promotional_pricing because memory_73 explicitly warns that while it acquires price-sensitive SMBs, it materially harms 30-day retention—misaligned with sustainable revenue. Referral_incentive targets existing customers when our core issue is new activation. Enterprise_sales_assist would be stronger long-term but requires longer sales cycles we don't have capacity for this week. A standard_experiment on onboarding simplification directly addresses both the activation and completion declines while maintaining our retention and LTV profile.
